company.introduction: Aviva provides insurance, retirement and wealth products to individuals and businesses, with major operations in the UK, Ireland and Canada. Its offerings include motor and home insurance, commercial cover, life protection, pensions and annuities, alongside investment-management services. Revenue and earnings arise through underwriting, investment-related activities and charges for savings and financial products. General insurance depends on pricing and claims costs, while retirement products involve managing liabilities and assets over much longer periods. Its combination of businesses creates several sources of customer income, but also requires careful capital and risk management. Distribution partnerships, customer retention and service quality support relationships across different life stages.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
